summary: Backblaze, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing its intention to offer $150 million aggregate principal amount of Convertible Senior Notes due 2031 in a Rule 144A private placement, with an initial purchasers' option for an additional $22.5 million. The issuer will use part of the net proceeds to fund capped call transactions and the remainder for general corporate purposes and capital expenditures. Concurrently, Backblaze amended its credit agreement to permit the notes and capped calls, and plans a fifth amendment increasing revolving capacity from $20 million to $50 million, extending maturity to April 30, 2030, and modifying financial covenants. This is a financing event, not a special-situation category. Watch for pricing and note terms.
